pages.title: About the market
pages.content:
About the market

Hinata Market was established in spring 2011 when nine local growers and the Linden Station community council set up the first trestle tables on Linden Station Square, Easthaven. Rows C and D were added in 2015, and the weekly list started in November 2022.

Forty growers sell here every Saturday from 08:00 to 14:00. Everything on a stall is grown, reared or made by the people standing behind it, within sixty kilometres of the square.

pages.title: Stalls and growers
pages.content:
Stalls and growers

Forty pitches in four rows: Row A greens and eggs, Row B bread and fruit, Row C dairy, honey and preserves, Row D roots and the knife sharpener.

pages.title: In season
pages.content:
In season

November brings squash, leeks, apples and pears, walnuts, kale and chard to the square, and goat cheese until mid-December.

pages.title: Visit
pages.content:
Visit

Linden Station Square, Easthaven, between the station’s east exit and the tram stop. Open every Saturday 08:00–14:00; December to February 09:00–13:00. Card and cash at all forty stalls.

pages.title: Apply for a pitch
pages.content:
Apply for a pitch

Applications are read on the 1st of each month and answered within ten working days. Email hello@hinata-market.example with your farm, how far it is from the square and what you would bring.

pages.title: Pitch fees
pages.content:
Pitch fees

Full pitch €38, half pitch €22, corner pitch €46, season pass (12 Saturdays) €396, trial Saturday €19, power hook-up €6, market awning loan €8. Paid by card at the visitor desk or by invoice for season passes.

pages.title: Weekly list
pages.content:
Weekly list

One email every Thursday at 18:00: next Saturday’s stalls, what is in season, market notices and a note from one grower.

pages.title: Contact
pages.content:
Contact

Market office: Linden Station Square, Easthaven. Tuesday to Thursday 10:00–16:00, tel. 020 448 6130, hello@hinata-market.example. Saturday visitor desk at pitch A1.

pages.title: Privacy
pages.content:
Privacy

This sample site stores nothing about visitors. If you email the market office, your message and address are used only to reply.

posts.title: A honey stall joins Row C from 28 November
posts.excerpt: Linden Honey takes pitch C7 from Saturday 28 November.
posts.content:
Linden Honey joins Row C from Saturday 28 November at pitch C7. The beekeeper completed her two trial Saturdays in October and Amara Osei visited the hives within three weeks of her application.

Jars are filled within sixty kilometres of the square. Bring your own bag; card and cash are taken at the stall.

posts.title: Bicycle parking moves to the east arcade
posts.excerpt: From Saturday 21 November cargo bikes and bicycles park in the east arcade.
posts.content:
From Saturday 21 November, bicycles and cargo bikes park in the covered east arcade, beside the tram stop. The east gate opens at 07:30 for cargo bikes carrying crates.

The racks beside pitch A1 are kept clear for the visitor desk.

posts.title: Soup Saturday on 5 December: bring a bowl
posts.excerpt: A big pot of seasonal soup at 11:00 on 5 December. Bring your own bowl.
posts.content:
On Saturday 5 December a volunteer ladles seasonal soup from a large pot at 11:00. Bring your own bowl and spoon; there are no disposables on the square.

The vegetables come from rows B and D.

posts.title: The knife sharpener is back on the first Saturday of each month
posts.excerpt: Knife sharpening returns to pitch D9 on the first Saturday of each month.
posts.content:
The knife sharpener is back at pitch D9 on the first Saturday of each month. Leave a knife wrapped in cloth and collect it before 14:00.

It is the one stall that sells a service rather than produce, so it sits at the end of Row D.
